They already know your credentials at this point so I suspect they will be looking to see if you will blend in and play nice with the others.

To answer the question "why did you leave your last job..." be direct yet pleasant about it. Never sound like you have a grudge even if you do. Don't over explain. Doing so sounds like you are trying to manipulate or lie. Be confident! You might say "medical reasons" or something like that. Something abstract yet clear and too personal for them to dig more.
